mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a comfortable 67 degrees under clear skies at the Military Ridge State Trail, paired with a beautiful waning crescent moon overhead.
The City of Verona maintains a consistent schedule for infrastructure management, contracting with AECOM Incorporated to deliver engineering reports to the city council at every council meeting.

Today is packed with local highlights, including the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol and live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event.
In a notable report from Thursday, July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop due to a vehicle operating on a flat tire, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O W I.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open at 10 AM.
